title: Linear-Programming Sharpness and Universal Lattice Optimality
exact_target: Does the linear-programming auxiliary-function method prove universal optimality for a finite spherical configuration exactly when the linear-programming bound for spherical codes is sharp for that configuration; and does its Euclidean analogue prove universal optimality for the hexagonal lattice, the $E_8$ root lattice, and the Leech lattice?
